name: Pos Malaysia Berhad
summary: Pos Malaysia Berhad, headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, operates as a diversified service provider specializing in postal, courier, and logistics solutions for both domestic and international markets. The company's operations are structured into three key segments: Postal, Aviation, and Logistics. Under its Postal segment, Pos Malaysia handles the collection and delivery of mail, provides an array of postal financial services, and sells philatelic products and postage stamps. This segment delivers essential mail services to corporate and individual clients, in addition to mailroom management, direct marketing mail, and over-the-counter bill payment options. It also facilitates various financial products, direct entry, and transshipment services, notably through its SendParcel online platform for seamless domestic and international courier bookings. The Aviation and Logistics divisions collectively provide extensive parcel and freight services, utilizing sea, air, and land transportation for national and global destinations. Their offerings include cargo and ground handling, in-flight catering, freight forwarding, air cargo transport, and haulage. Complementary services extend to shipping agency and chartering, secure storage and safekeeping, along with comprehensive warehousing and distribution solutions. Furthermore, Pos Malaysia's broad business interests encompass data and document processing, customs forwarding, aircraft maintenance and engineering, and inventory management. The company also engages in supplying internet security products and services, trading investment precious metals like gold bars and dinars, document printing, digital certification authority licensing, property investment, Islamic pawn brokering, insurance agency, and the development and management of distribution parks.
